1240	
1241	    Mirrors the bundle verifier's trust rules; a ``genesis_hash`` is not
1242	    required here because the caller pins the range anchor directly. The
1243	    optional GET /v1/trust ``source_key_history`` mapping is validated too:
1244	    each source maps to a non-empty ascending array of
1245	    ``{version, public_key, activated_event_id}`` items whose versions are
1246	    dense from 1 with strictly ascending activation ids, both numeric fields
1247	    non-boolean positive integers and the public key 64 lowercase hex.
1248	    """
1249	    if not isinstance(trust, dict):
1250	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1251	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
1252	    if not isinstance(sources, dict):
1253	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1254	    for name, entry in sources.items():
1255	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(entry, dict):
1256	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1257	        if not _is_int(entry.get("expires_at")):
1258	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1259	        public_key = entry.get("public_key")
1260	        # Ed25519 public keys are 32 raw bytes, i.e. 64 hex characters.
1261	        if not isinstance(public_key, str) or not _HEX32_RE.fullmatch(public_key):
1262	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1263	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
1264	    if not isinstance(allowlist, dict):
1265	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1266	    for name, expires_at in allowlist.items():
1267	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not _is_int(expires_at):
1268	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1269	    history = trust.get("source_key_history")
1270	    if history is not None:
1271	        if not isinstance(history, dict):
1272	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1273	        for name, entries in history.items():
1274	            if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
1275	                raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1276	            if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
1277	                raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1278	            last_activated = None
1279	            for position, entry in enumerate(entries):
1280	                if not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != set(

1282	                ):
1283	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)

1285	                public_key = entry.get("public_key")
1286	                activated = entry.get("activated_event_id")
1287	                # Versions are dense from 1; both numeric fields are plain
1288	                # (non-boolean) positive integers.

1290	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)

1292	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1293	                if not _is_int(activated) or activated < 1:
1294	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1295	                if last_activated is not None and activated <= last_activated:
1296	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)

1305	def _authenticate_range_export(document: dict, trust: dict, now: float) -> None:
1306	    """Check mode-specific source authorization and every deadline.
1307	
1308	    A ``plain`` export is only acceptable from an allowlisted source and must
1309	    carry ``attestation: null``. An ``attested`` export is authorized one of
1310	    two ways:
1311	
1312	    * the trust document carries a ``source_key_history`` mapping (the new
1313	      rule): the source must appear in the mapping — the historical public key
1314	      matching and signature verification happen by attestation version in
1315	      :func:`_verify_range_attestation`; the trust ``sources`` entry and its
1316	      deadline play no role, so a delivery signed under a since-rotated or
1317	      revoked key still authenticates as long as the document itself is
1318	      unexpired;
1319	    * the mapping is absent (the legacy rule): the source must be a
1320	      ``sources`` entry whose unexpired deadline is checked.
1321	
1322	    All deadlines are checked before any integrity work: an expired,
1323	    correctly-signed export is still unusable.
1324	    """
1325	    source = document["source"]
1326	    mode = document["mode"]
1327	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
1328	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
1329	    if mode == "plain":
1330	        if source not in allowlist:
1331	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1332	        # A plain export carrying an attestation is not a plain delivery.
1333	        if document["attestation"] is not None:
1334	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1335	    elif _has_key_history(trust):
1336	        # Historical-key authorization: the source (and later the attestation
1337	        # version) must resolve in the mapping; the current registry entry is
1338	        # deliberately not consulted.
1339	        if source not in trust["source_key_history"]:
1340	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1341	    elif source not in sources:
1342	        raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1343	
1344	    if document["expires_at"] <= now:
1345	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
1346	    if mode == "plain":
1347	        if allowlist[source] <= now:
1348	            raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
1349	    elif not _has_key_history(trust) and sources[source]["expires_at"] <= now:
1350	        # Legacy rule only: the pinned registry entry's own deadline applies.
1351	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)

1354	def _recompute_range_tail(anchor: dict, blocks_raw: list) -> list[Block]:
1355	    """Recompute and validate the delivered tail standalone from the anchor.
1356	
1357	    Mirrors the node's own range-tail rules: heights run consecutively from
1358	    ``anchor.height + 1``, the first ``prev_hash`` is the anchor hash and
1359	    later ones link internally, every transaction's tx_id and Ed25519
1360	    signature verifies, tx_ids are unique across the tail and ascending
1361	    inside each block, Merkle roots and block hashes recompute, and a pending
1362	    block may only sit at the tail tip. Every field is checked on the *raw*
1363	    JSON value; type/domain defects (non-integer or negative height,
1364	    non-positive or non-integer amount) are reported as ``input``, while
1365	    recomputation mismatches stay ``integrity``.
1366	    """
1367	    blocks: list[Block] = []
1368	    seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
1369	    for position, block_raw in enumerate(blocks_raw):
1370	        if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
1371	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1372	        height = block_raw.get("height")
1373	        prev_hash = block_raw.get("prev_hash")
1374	        merkle_root = block_raw.get("merkle_root")
1375	        block_hash = block_raw.get("block_hash")
1376	        status = block_raw.get("status")
1377	        txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
1378	        # Same rule as the whole-chain recomputation: a height of the wrong
1379	        # type or sign is a field-type defect (input), never coerced.
1380	        if not _is_int(height) or height < 0:
1381	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1382	        if not isinstance(prev_hash, str):
1383	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1384	        if not crypto.is_hex64(merkle_root) or not crypto.is_hex64(block_hash):
1385	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)

1387	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1388	        if height != anchor["height"] + 1 + position:
1389	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1390	        expected_prev = (
1391	            anchor["block_hash"] if position == 0 else blocks[position - 1].block_hash
1392	        )
1393	        if prev_hash != expected_prev:
1394	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1395	        if position < len(blocks_raw) - 1 and status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
1396	            # A pending block may only sit at the tail tip.
1397	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1398	
1399	        tx_ids: list[str] = []
1400	        for raw_tx in txs_raw:
1401	            if not isinstance(raw_tx, dict):
1402	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1403	            sender = raw_tx.get("from")
1404	            recipient = raw_tx.get("to")
1405	            amount = raw_tx.get("amount")
1406	            signature = raw_tx.get("signature")
1407	            stored_tx_id = raw_tx.get("tx_id")
1408	            if not isinstance(sender, str) or not sender:
1409	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1410	            if not isinstance(recipient, str) or not recipient:
1411	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1412	            # The raw amount must already be a non-boolean positive integer —
1413	            # never a coercible string, float or bool.
1414	            if not _is_int(amount) or amount <= 0:
1415	                raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1416	            if not isinstance(signature, str) or not signature:
1417	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)

1419	            tx_id = crypto.compute_tx_id(message)
1420	            if stored_tx_id != tx_id or not crypto.is_hex64(stored_tx_id):
1421	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1422	            if not crypto.verify_signature(sender, message, signature):
1423	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1424	            if tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
1425	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)

1427	            tx_ids.append(tx_id)
1428	        if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
1429	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)

1464

1466	
1467	    * with ``source_key_history`` present, the attestation's ``version``
1468	      selects the source's historical public key; the source not appearing in
1469	      the mapping, or the attestation version not being one of its dense
1470	      versions, is an authorization failure (``auth``), as is a mismatch
1471	      between the attestation's ``public_key`` and that historical key. The
1472	      Ed25519 signature is then checked over the SHA-256 digest of the
1473	      canonical ``ledger-sync-range-v1`` message — a wrong signature is an
1474	      integrity failure. The attestation's version is already structurally
1475	      guaranteed to be a positive integer.
1476	    * without the mapping (legacy rule), the attestation's ``public_key``
1477	      must be exactly the key the trust document pins in ``sources`` for the
1478	      source (a mismatched credential is an authorization failure) and the

1489	        # version simply indexes the ascending history.
1490	        if version < 1 or version > len(history):

1494	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)

1502	        document["expires_at"],
1503	        document["anchor"],
1504	        document["blocks"],
1505	        document["tip"],
1506	    )

1508	    if not crypto.verify_signature(pinned, digest, attestation["signature"]):
